text:
maria (AE): @devon @karthik quick heads-up — Veridian wants a short POC next week. They plan to upload a private 10GB corpus and run chat+retrieval against a custom fork of q-omega14-ggml (14B). Need: model catalog variant, per-tenant KV cache, token billing clarity, and an SLA. Can we confirm compat + rough pricing?

devon (engineer): Quick question — does the fork change KV layout or attention block types? Our 4-bit quant pipeline supports RMSNorm and rotary, but interleaved KV needs mapping. Any model artifacts we can peek at?

maria (AE): They attached a manifest link: https://files.veridian/example-manifest.json — main flag: "kv_layer_order": "interleaved" and uses rotary embeddings. No obvious custom ops.

karthik (ml-eng): rotary embeddings are fine. Interleaved KV is a known gap but we have a small adapter shim we can build into a catalog variant. We need a conversion step: convert_kv_layout.py --src model.bin --dst model_interleaved.bin and run KV unit tests. Estimate 2 dev-days to validate and create variant image.

jessica (sales-eng): Pricing ballpark for POC: if they want dedicated capacity (private infra in eu-west-1) for 2 weeks with 4 pods (A100 equiv) I'm estimating $6k–$9k. Hosted burst path (no private infra) ~ $9k–$13k. I'll formalize after we lock throughput numbers. :money_with_wings: 

ops-bot: action required — customer requests data residency in eu-west-1 and SOC2 attestation. Private deployment recommended. Provision lead time: 5 business days.

sophie (security): Confirmed — we'll need their admin contact + data flow diagram and to validate KMS/HSM key wrapping. Private control plane OK. I'll start the security questionnaire; ping me the contact.

devon (engineer): Ops config notes (for reproducibility):
```yaml
model_variant: veridian-qomega14-interleaved
runtime:
  quant: 4bit
  kv_adapter: interleaved-shim-v1
cache:
  type: prefix_kv
  per_tenant: true
batcher: auto
```
Run warmup with 2 parallel streams and check KV state with `kv_check --slot 0 --hash 1234`.

maria (AE): Perfect. Can we convert this into clear action items? Veridian wants a canary by next Monday.

karthik (ml-eng): Action list:
- devon: run conversion + unit tests (ETA 2 business days)
- ops (sophie/infra): spin private env in eu-west-1 + KMS (ETA 5 business days)
- jessica: draft POC quote with burst vs dedicated pricing (ETA EOD today)
- maria: collect customer admin + data map and return security questionnaire (owner: maria)
I'll own the rollout script and variant bake.

jessica (sales-eng): Copy — drafting quote now, will post versioned doc here when ready. :thumbsup: 

maria (AE): Thanks everyone — I'll ping Veridian and collect the contact info. Keeping this thread as single source of truth.
